verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a SaaS email service, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party MCP server or endpoint. The JMAP API, session discovery and API tokens are developer building blocks someone could use to build an MCP server; they are not an official MCP server and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
